groups.name: INSURANCE SCOPE
groups.covers: BLOCKER-INSURANCE-01: ZIP/city-only requests hand off to the local directory instead of returning an unscoped agency cohort; named-insurer requests still resolve via identity_name mode.

groups.name: IDENTIFIER FILLERS
groups.covers: BLOCKER-IDENTIFIER-FILLER-WORD-01: 'NAIC code 10064' / 'NPN number ...' / 'CRD number ...' / 'NMLS number ...' style filler words no longer break identifier extraction, across anchored and unanchored entry points.

groups.name: SENIOR DEICTIC
groups.covers: BLOCKER-SENIOR-01: 'this nursing home' / 'this assisted living facility' / 'this hospice' style deictic references no longer get fabricated into a literal entity name.

groups.name: CONTRACTOR
groups.covers: BLOCKER-CONTRACTOR-01: the stale contractFingerprint version-lock no longer fails closed on a legitimate, correctly-versioned contractor request; contractVersion/schemaFingerprint checks remain enforced.

groups.name: CROSS DOMAIN
groups.covers: BLOCKER-CROSS-01: structural multi-domain conjunction detection (e.g. 'a mover and a lender') routes to disclosed clarification instead of silently executing only one domain.

newSuiteBreakdown.note: Each group includes at least one positive case, one negative/control case proving the fix does not over-trigger on a superficially similar but legitimately different phrasing, and one mutation-style assertion tied to the specific code change.
